system.description: Binary is the primary language of Droids. This Translator Unit is installed on a Droid's Basic-output jack, a standard jack found on most Droids that enables them to connect to a terminal or a Datapad and to express themselves in written Basic. The translator converts audible Binary into audible Basic, transmitting the spoken words to an earphone receiver. The less expensive version requires a large headphone set, while the more expensive version transmits to an earbud receiver. Detecting the earbud requires a Perception check of DC 20.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
